Health and housekeeping

What is solid, and what is left to tidy.

prippen RAMHome Assistant has 7 of prippen's 7.5 GB. Move HA to turbo (planned 19 Oct, USB sticks by hand).
Old kernelsedvin 12, turbo 5, prippen 3 installed. Purge command in the 19 Oct task list.
Secrets shown in chatGrafana admin and Genelec passwords, an HA token: change/revoke.
Pi-hole without passwordBoth admin pages are open on the LAN; the monitoring and panels use the API.
Stale DHCP reservationsRouter still reserves .31 'wireguard', .53 'gotify' and .54 'myspeed' for old MACs (guests use static IPs).
Router forwardOld WireGuard forward 63778 → .31 (now Pi-hole 2) should be deleted.
Duplicate lock entityHA has lock.front_door (often unavailable) and lock.front_door_2; remove the dead one.
BackupsAll guests on all nodes go to PBS nightly (turbo 02:30, edvin 03:15, prippen Sun 03:00 to the file share).
Internet exposureOnly edge (.40) and the winrepo passthrough (8443) are reachable from outside; edge has a deny-by-default firewall.
DNS redundancyTwo Pi-holes on different nodes, synced every 15 min (blocking state excluded since 19 Oct).
